title: Google Product snippet
notes: An Offer needs price or priceSpecification.price; an AggregateOffer needs lowPrice, so lowPrice is accepted too.
Not checked: AggregateOffer requires lowPrice and priceCurrency and recommends highPrice and offerCount.
Not checked: an editorial review that uses positiveNotes or negativeNotes needs at least two statements in total.
Need ONE of review, aggregateRating, offers (the Rich Results Test warns if only offers is given).

Offer: price (or priceSpecification.price) required; price may be 0 for free; if both price and priceSpecification given, price wins. priceCurrency recommended here (required for merchant listings). availability: single value, schema.org ItemAvailability (BackOrder, Discontinued, InStock, InStoreOnly, LimitedAvailability, OnlineOnly, OutOfStock, PreOrder, PreSale, SoldOut; short names accepted). priceValidUntil Date; past date may suppress the snippet.
AggregateOffer (don't use for variants): required lowPrice, priceCurrency; recommended highPrice, offerCount; price-drop enhancement needs Offer not AggregateOffer.
Reviewer name must be a valid Person or Team name.
Pros/cons: editorial review needs at least two statements across positiveNotes/negativeNotes (ItemList with ListItem.name required, position recommended).
Review and AggregateRating sub-rules: see Review snippet.
